registered_at: 2026-09-20 (v0.2, registered before its run; fixes evaluation-contract defects found in v0/v0.1, MS-135/136)
status: registered before execution; P1 first independent experiment (design doc §8.3, audit §6)
question: In hiroshima, with all 15 acquisitions arriving in order (cloudy ones included), does a learned observation-corrected state confirm the landslide earlier than last-observation / EMA / running-mean / Δt-GRU states at the same pre-event false-alarm rate, using the frozen sealed readout?
data: arrival_v0/hiroshima (single_fp16, prefix_fp16, meta); readout resolution_contract_v2/p4_native_control/holdout_hiroshima_seed1 (frozen); normalisation stats from the sealed train cache as in training
split: tile-id hash into 5 blocks: train {0,1,2}, val {3}, test {4}. Pseudo-spatial (adjacent tiles may share blocks) — stated limitation. Single event date for the whole region: tiles are spatial replicates of ONE event; CIs are over tiles and do not license event-level generalisation.
state_init: m_0 = single_0 for all arms (no lookahead)

arms.ema: m_i = (1-a) m_{i-1} + a single_i, a learned scalar
arms.resid_q: PROPOSED: m_i = m_{i-1} + g ⊙ f([m, u, u - P(m)]), gate g from [m, u, u-P(m), q_i, Δt_i] (quality- and innovation-conditioned correction); no uncertainty head in v0
arms.prefix: full re-encoding of the arrival prefix (teacher; cost reference, not a physical ceiling)
arms.latest_head: latest-only control v2: 1x1 head on the single-observation state trained with TEMPORAL-CONTRAST labels — for positive train tiles, pre-event steps carry the zero label with the same weight as post-event steps carry the mask; no pos_weight; negative tiles included. Automatic invalidation if realised test pre-event FAR >= 3x budget.
arms.meta_only: control: state evolved from m_0 with Δt/day-of-year/region only, no observations after step 0 (detects memorised event timing)
arms.sealed12: readout sanity only: ONE decision per tile (area of the full-year sealed state >= threshold); reported as fraction of positive test tiles above threshold and pre-event-free false alarm on negative tiles; no latency

training: learned arms: teacher = prefix state at each step, MSE, closed-loop rollout from step 1..14, AdamW 1e-3, 30 epochs, batch 8 tiles, seed 1 (seeds 2-3 if seed 1 shows an effect); GPU0
detection_rule: predicted-positive area (readout prob > .5) in window 8..120 >= A_thr; A_thr set PER ARM on the validation block so that the pre-event step-level false-alarm rate = 5% (steps with no post-event observation in the prefix). Test reports the realised pre-event FAR.
metrics: days-to-confirmation per positive test tile: date of the first post-event step with detection minus event_date (fallback: first post-event acquisition date); censored if never
paired bootstrap (tiles) of days-to-confirmation and of IoU: resid_q vs gru_dt and vs last
cost: encoded timestep-units per tile per arrival (1 for streaming arms, min(c,12) for prefix)
latency reference B: days from the first VALID post-event observation (clear >= .5) to confirmation
confirmation rate and number of never-confirmed (censored) tiles reported alongside every latency median
meta_only must not confirm above the pre-event FAR; if it does, timing memorisation is flagged

decision_rules.method_signal: resid_q median days-to-confirmation < gru_dt AND < last with paired-bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0, at matched 5% pre-event FAR, AND post-event IoU not worse than gru_dt by more than .02
decision_rules.no_signal: otherwise: report table; no method claim; Δt-GRU or last-observation remains the recommendation
decision_rules.sanity: prefix arm must confirm >= 90% of positive tiles at the 10% tile-level budget; else the contract is still broken and nothing is interpreted
decision_rules.latest_head_validity: realised pre-event FAR < 3x budget, else arm invalid

objectives_note: v0.1 keeps teacher-MSE training for comparability; the evidence-based early-confirmation objective (design doc §9.2) is v1 and needs its own contract
far_budget_unit: TILE level: a validation tile is a false alarm if ANY pre-event step's predicted-positive area >= threshold; threshold chosen so that 5% (and 10%) of validation tiles are false alarms. Test reports realised tile-level pre-event FAR.
